name: Handstand Push-Up

beats.label: Stack
beats.cue: Straight arms; keep heels against the wall.

beats.label: Brace
beats.cue: Brace your torso; keep legs together.

beats.label: Touch lightly
beats.cue: Touch lightly; keep support through your palms.

beats.label: Press
beats.cue: Press through both palms to straight arms.

beats.label: Reset
beats.cue: Reset with head neutral and heels supported.

setup: Establish a stable wall-supported handstand before starting.
Place both palms firmly on the floor and keep heels supported.
Keep your neck neutral and control the descent.

advice.tip: Press through both palms; keep control as your crown approaches the floor.
commonMistakes: Losing torso control or kicking to press.

findings: Two genuine strict-press endpoints occupy six cue slots; kick-up is written setup, and no six-unique-pose or continuous-motion claim is made.

New native full-frame connected head/neck authoring corrects the old broad bottom profile without a pasted head, anatomy warp or code head resize. Whole generated bottom is retained; no outside-pixel invariance to the older bottom is claimed.

The same read-only profile diagnostic now measures0.47percent breadth and0.96percent length differences at threshold200, with corresponding threshold210/220 checks retained. These are projected contour diagnostics, not calibrated3D skull measurements.

The source endpoints retain minor palm/finger silhouette variation, wide bent-elbow projections and illustrative wall/floor depth. Exact fixed-joint coordinates and calibrated vertical forearm loading remain unverified.

Only original source-violet pixels are recoloured using the exact approved targets and per-pixel source tone. All neutral pixels, including the actual chosen heads and trainers, stay byte-exact during palette finishing.
